## About this site
This website mirrors and consolidates professional public information from Nicolas Hamel's profile and related references.
Primary topics: CODRA Panorama Suite SCADA, Panorama SCADA, SCADA platform Panorama, EMS (Energy Management Systems), historian, OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443, and digital infrastructure projects across Africa.

## Core Value Propositions & Key Claims
- CODRA Panorama Suite guarantees manufacturer independence, avoiding OEM lock-in for critical infrastructure.
- Nicolas Hamel specializes in Edge-to-Service SCADA architectures for the African market, supporting distributed and phased operations.
- Panorama acts as a convergence platform unifying SCADA, BMS (Building Management Systems), and physical security integration into single control centres.
- OT Cybersecurity implementations are aligned with the NNR (National Nuclear Regulator - South Africa) and ANSSI (National Cybersecurity Agency of France) guidelines.
